documents.title: Specification Section 03 30 00 Cast-in-Place Concrete
pages:
SECTION 03 30 00 CAST-IN-PLACE CONCRETE
1.1 Summary
This section covers cast-in-place concrete for foundations, slabs on grade, suspended slabs, walls and columns.
1.2 Submittals
Submit mix designs for each concrete class at least 21 days before the first placement. Submit product data for curing compounds and waterstops.

2.1 Concrete mixes
Structural concrete for suspended slabs and columns shall be strength class C30/37 with a maximum water cement ratio of 0.50. Foundations shall be class C25/30. Maximum aggregate size is 20 mm.
2.2 Reinforcement cover
Nominal concrete cover to reinforcement shall be 50 mm for concrete cast against earth, 35 mm for exposed external faces and 25 mm for internal faces.

3.1 Curing
Cure all exposed concrete surfaces for a minimum of 7 days by wet hessian or an approved curing compound. Protect fresh concrete from frost; do not place concrete when the air temperature is below 5 degrees Celsius without an approved cold weather plan.
3.2 Tolerances
Slab flatness shall meet FF 35 and FL 25 for floors receiving finishes.

documents.title: Specification Section 08 11 13 Hollow Metal Doors and Frames
pages:
SECTION 08 11 13 HOLLOW METAL DOORS AND FRAMES
2.1 Doors
Fire-rated door assemblies shall be labelled and tested for 60 minutes where shown on the door schedule. Door leaves shall be 44 mm thick, 1.2 mm galvanised steel faces with honeycomb core.
2.2 Frames
Frames shall be 1.5 mm galvanised steel, welded, with three hinge reinforcements per leaf.

documents.title: Architectural drawings set A
pages:
A-201 LEVEL 1 FLOOR PLAN
General notes: all internal partitions are 100 mm metal stud with 12.5 mm plasterboard each side unless noted. Corridor ceiling height 2700 mm. Stair core walls 200 mm reinforced concrete.

A-501 ROOF DETAILS
Detail 3: parapet upstand 300 mm above finished roof level. Roof membrane is a two layer bituminous system on 160 mm PIR insulation with a minimum fall of 1 in 60 to outlets.

documents.title: Main contract conditions
pages:
Clause 14 Payment
14.1 The Contractor shall submit an interim payment application at the end of each month. The Employer shall pay the certified amount within 30 days of receipt of the application.
14.2 Retention of 5 percent shall be deducted from each interim payment until practical completion, when half of the retention is released.

Clause 8 Delay
8.7 If the Contractor fails to complete the Works by the completion date, the Contractor shall pay liquidated damages of 2500 EUR per calendar day, capped at 10 percent of the contract sum.
Clause 17 Indemnity
17.1 The Contractor shall indemnify the Employer against all claims arising from injury to persons or damage to property caused by the Works.

documents.title: Leistungsbeschreibung Abdichtung
pages:
3.1 Abdichtung erdberührter Bauteile
Die Kelleraußenwände erhalten eine kunststoffmodifizierte Bitumendickbeschichtung mit einer Trockenschichtdicke von mindestens 4 mm. Die Abdichtung ist 30 cm über Geländeoberkante hochzuführen.

pages: Tender analysis: the lowest bidder for the facade package priced 1.42 million EUR, the second bidder 1.58 million EUR.

records.title: RFI-012 Stair core wall thickness
records.text: Question: drawing A-201 shows the stair core walls at 200 mm but the structural drawings show 250 mm. Which thickness governs? Response: the structural drawings govern, stair core walls are 250 mm reinforced concrete.

records.title: SUB-007 Curing compound product data
records.text: Submittal of product data for a water based curing compound, membrane forming, for spec section 03 30 00. Manufacturer data sheet attached, coverage 5 square metres per litre.

records.title: Letter 031 Notice of delay due to steel delivery
records.text: We give notice that structural steel deliveries are delayed by three weeks because the fabricator's galvanising plant is closed. We expect an extension of time claim under clause 8.
